CITY OF PASADENA
  Finance Committee and City Council Meeting

0  May 6, 2019-2:30 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber

  SPECIAL JOINT MEETING

  OPENING:  Mayor T ornek called the special joint meeting of the Finance
  Committee and City Council to order at 2:32 p.m. (Absent:
  Councilmembers Gordo, Hampton, Madison)

  ROLL CALL:
  Councilmembers:  Mayor Terry T ornek
  Vice Mayor John J. Kennedy
  Councilmember Victor Gordo
  Councilmember Tyron Hampton (Absent)
  Councilmember Steve Madison
  Councilmember Gene Masuda
  Councilmember Margaret McAustin
  Councilmember Andy Wilson

  Staff:  City Manager Steve Mermell
  City Attorney/City Prosecutor Michele Seal Bagneris
  City Clerk Mark Jomsky

0  The Finance Committee and City Council reviewed and
  discussed the following agenda items:

  CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM BUDGET AND THE
  FISCAL YEAR 2020 RECOMMENDED OPERATING
  BUDGET:
  Councilmember Gordo arrived
  at 3:13p.m.  •  City Council  •  City Clerk
  •  City Attorney  •  City Manager
  •  Police
  Councilmember Madison
  arrived at 5:19p.m.  For further details and information regarding the Budget
  discussions above, please see the approved Finance
  Committee minutes of May 6, 2019.

  Following discussion, on order of the Mayor, and consensus of
  the City Council, discussion on Pasadena Police Department
  budget would continue at the May 6, 2019 regular City Council
  meeting at 7:00 p.m. ·

  Joint Meeting Minutes  1  05/06/2019
   ADJOURNMENT  The special joint Finance Committee and City Council meeting
  adjourned at 5:29p.m.
